en: $024'327'3;$023'327'171'10'1;$022'327'304;Come to think of it, I guess▼it's kind of a sad memory...
$024'327'0;$023'327'1'4'0;I absolutely loved Santa, so one▼Christmas, I thought I'd do him▼a favor...

$024'327'0;$023'327'1'4'0;Tháng Giêng nào tớ cũng tự▼hỏi...

en: $024'327'6;$023'327'8'10'1;$022'327'382;Maybe it's so the adults don't▼waste too much time attending▼parties.

en: $024'327'0;$023'327'1'4'0;Every winter, my school has▼a talent show. Last year, I was▼asked to be a judge.

en: $024'327'0;$023'327'1'4'0;There's a memory that I recall▼each time it snows.

en: $024'327'1;$023'327'173'6'2;$022'327'341;One day, I was accumulating snow▼to build the perfect snowman.
